messages:
oliver: Morning — quick check: vendor called, says 8 A100 slots in apac-east1 will be available next week. Can someone confirm we can reserve 4 for the demo pool?
jiwoo: @oliver linked vendor ticket: https://vendor.example/t/12345. Vendor ETA 2026-03-25. Current quota for project:redwood-apac is 12, usage 10 (so 2 free).
samir: Can we free 2 by draining ephemeral jobs? Nightly sweep could be bumped earlier.
oliver: Prefer not to evict prod ephemerals. If we can push a quota request today, maybe approval by Tue.
jiwoo: Filed quota request: Q-9876. Command I ran: `gcloud compute regions quotas change --region=asia-east1 --metric=GPUS --amount=6 --project=redwood-apac` — added details in the ticket.
infra-bot: Deploy ticket created: DPL-7899 to add new demo pool nodes when quota is approved.
kate: Heads-up: reserving 4 A100s for demo will add ~ $7k/mo to demo budget. Need finance OK.
oliver: Budget is okay for Q2 demos. Can we also set an auto-burst fallback to T4 to reduce costs when load is low? :thinking:
samir: We can set fallback to T4/spot; perf will drop but demos still usable. Recommend max_spot_percent 60.
jiwoo: Proposed plan: 1) Hold 4 slots with vendor 2) Wait for quota Q-9876 approval 3) Terraform change to reserve count + autoscaler fallback 4) Notify demo owners and tag resources. I'll open the PR.
oliver: @kate please confirm budget approval so we can reserve. :eyes:
kate: Approved. Please add tag `demo-reserved` and include monthly cost estimate in PR.
jiwoo: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/542 — adds `reserved_demo_gpu_count = 4` and autoscaler fallback settings.
samir: Quick snippet for autoscaler in Terraform (pasted into PR description):
```
resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "demo" {
  name        = "demo-apac-pool"
  gpu_type    = "a100"
  reserved    = 4
  fallback {
    type            = "t4"
    max_spot_percent = 60
  }
}
```
oliver: LGTM, thanks.
kate: :rocket: please include monthly cost line in PR.
infra-bot: Ticket Q-9876 status updated: PENDING_VENDOR_ACTION.
jiwoo: Will follow up with vendor tomorrow morning if ETA doesn't firm up.
oliver: Great — I'll schedule the drain window for the ephemeral sweep as a fallback if quota doesn't land in time.
thread_summary: Vendor ETA for apac A100s; quota request Q-9876 filed; plan to reserve 4 A100s for demo pool, set fallback to T4/spot, PR opened, budget approved by Kate.
